meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: Claude 会安装 OneCLI,初始化它的 Agent Vault 密钥库,把 .env 里的密钥迁入并从 .env 删除。之后网关会在请求时自动注入密钥,AI 代理看不到原始密钥。还能给不同代理分配密钥、设置限流和策略。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 把 OneCLI 作为重大变更引入后,或首次设置 OneCLI、需要从头安装时触发。

say.text: 运行 /init-onecli,开始安装 OneCLI 并迁移凭据。
say.note: 会先检查现状,再安装和迁移。
检测到重大变更后开始初始化。

say.text: 初始化 OneCLI,把 .env 里的密钥迁到 Agent Vault。
say.note: 迁移完会从 .env 删除原始密钥。

howto.what_en: Claude installs OneCLI, initializes its Agent Vault, moves .env credentials into it, and removes them from .env. Secrets are gateway-injected at request time, so agents never see raw keys. Can assign per-agent secrets and set rate limits.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup / when a fresh install is needed.

say_en.text: Run /init-onecli to install OneCLI and migrate credentials.
say_en.note: Checks current state, then installs and migrates.

say_en.text: I just ran /update-nanoclaw; please run init-onecli.
say_en.note: Starts initialization after the breaking change.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and move .env keys to Agent Vault.
